description: Turn every page, or the pages named, clockwise by 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Free, with a daily limit per account. Give the file through get_upload_link (file_id) or a public link. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

angle.description: Degrees clockwise. Use 270 to turn left.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the PDF there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to the PDF. A result link from another YangOpen tool works too.

pages.description: Pages, counting from 1: "1-3,5", "8-" (8 to the end) or "last". Default: every page.

name: rotate_pdf
title: Rotate PDF pages
